angles.headline: What sets the price of a painting? An insider on the world's least transparent market
angles.pitch: Avery explains how prices, hype and provenance really work at the blue-chip level, from placing a $100K+ Hap Tivey work at Art Basel Miami Beach to advising celebrity collectors.
angles.builds_on: Oliver Bullough 'Moneyland' (229) and the show's recurring wealth/opacity guests

angles.headline: A fascinating-life-story episode: from Miami dealer to building a global street-art brand
angles.pitch: How Avery developed Alec Monopoly into a global brand with sold-out exhibitions from New York to Morocco, and championed Hebru Brantley and Jammie Holmes early.
angles.builds_on: Show's 'Extraordinary Lives' strand and life-story guests (e.g., Andrea Wulf, Ed Cowan)

angles.headline: Art, money and the internet: from the first online blue-chip gallery to selling a prison badge as an NFT
angles.pitch: Avery on launching ArtLife.com in 2015, coining Click & Mortar, and the ArtGrails NFT era (Michael Cohen's prison badge, reported by Vanity Fair).
angles.builds_on: Show's economics/systems episodes (semiconductors, Moneyland, Treasure Islands)
